# PawHaus Resort

> Twelve glass-and-pine cabins on 30 private acres in Goodrich, TX. The USA's first dog-first luxury nature hotel. Opening January 1, 2027.

PawHaus Resort is a luxury dog-first destination where every cabin is designed paw-up: fenced yards at every door, in-cabin doggy treat bars, on-site dog spa, wood-fired hot tubs, and 30 acres of private off-leash roaming with a 24/7 vetted vet partner four minutes away.

Currently in public pre-launch: 30% off all cabins, no code required. Doors open to public bookings January 1, 2027.

## Cabin tiers

- [Petite](https://pawhausresort.com/booking): Cozy mirrored cabin for 1-2 humans + 1-2 dogs. Doggy treat bar, private yard, dog spa access. From $195/night pre-launch.
- [Standard](https://pawhausresort.com/booking): Signature lakefront cabin for 2-4 humans + up to 2 dogs. All Petite amenities plus expanded kitchen and living space. From $276/night pre-launch.
- [Monolith](https://pawhausresort.com/booking): Premium cabin for 2-4 humans + up to 2 dogs. Wood-fired hot tub, outdoor fire pit, expanded lakefront views. From $417/night pre-launch.

## Property amenities

- 30 acres of private off-leash roaming trails
- On-site PawHaus Dog Spa (one complimentary pick per stay)
- DIY dog wash stations with warm water and blow-dryers
- Nature Dog Park with splash pool
- Indoor climate-controlled play lounge
- Lobby coffee bar with pup cups every morning
- Human wellness spa with massages and facials
- Twilight pool with lake views
- Wood-fired hot tubs (Monolith tier)
- Vetted 24/7 vet partner 4 minutes from property

## What makes PawHaus different

Every touchpoint is designed for dogs, not tolerating them. No pet fees. No apologies. A dog bed in every cabin by default. A treat bar stocked to your dog's size. Fenced private yards at every door. Vet partner on speed dial.

## Charitable giving

A portion of every booking goes to a rotating list of East Texas and Houston-area animal shelters, currently SPCA of Polk County and Houston SPCA.

## Booking

- [Book a stay](https://pawhausresort.com/booking): Live booking with Stripe, Apple Pay, Google Pay. No code needed for the 30% pre-launch discount.
